Name: Grandpa Has a Propeller Hat
Author: hotsaucewhiskey
Description:
adds a little whimsy by giving our beloved grandpa a silly propeller hat and lollipop in his last moments

i made this as a way to get acquainted with creating content packs for stardew valley

special thanks to [b]Novamare[/b]!! their mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11829]Grandpa is the bed[/url] was super duper helpful as reference for troubleshooting the initial version of this mod
